# Josh Eudy, Realtor

> Josh Eudy is a licensed North Carolina real estate broker (#300792) with Realty ONE Group Revolution, based at 915 Vernon Dr, Jacksonville, NC. He is a U.S. Army veteran and Military Relocation Professional, and an active cash buyer. Sellers can get two numbers from him: a list price and a cash offer. He serves Jacksonville, Onslow County and the coast from Hampstead to Emerald Isle, including Sneads Ferry, Hubert, Swansboro, Holly Ridge, Surf City and Topsail Island.

Contact: (910) 333-5433, homessoldbyjosh@gmail.com. Instagram: @realtor.nc.

## Core pages
- [Sell your house](https://josheudy.com/sell): Listing strategy, pricing and a free broker's price range for Onslow County homes.
- [Cash offer](https://josheudy.com/cash-offer): How Josh buys houses directly, including inherited homes, estates, land and mobile homes. Purchases are made for his own account and disclosed in writing.
- [Buy a home](https://josheudy.com/buy): Buying in Jacksonville and Onslow County, including PCS moves to Camp Lejeune and MCAS New River.
- [Rent](https://josheudy.com/rent): Rentals and rent-before-you-buy guidance.
- [Areas](https://josheudy.com/areas): Town-by-town guide to the service area.
- [About Josh](https://josheudy.com/agents): Background, license and production.
- [Tools](https://josheudy.com/tools): Mortgage and cost calculators and an area matcher.
- [Contact](https://josheudy.com/contact)
